brief: How a solo founder ships like a Meta team — 8 internal tools every operator should clone.

slots.body: Solo founders move slow because they lack the internal tooling giants take for granted.

slots.title: Write a
slots.body: Meta engineers don’t ship without an RFC. Solo founders should write a one-page PRD before any build. It kills scope creep and aligns your future self.

slots.title: Async daily
slots.body: Replace meetings with a 3-bullet update: yesterday, today, blockers. Use a Notion page or Slack bot to track momentum without the Zoom fatigue.

slots.title: Centralize the
slots.body: Create a single Figma hub with logos, colors, copy snippets, and templates. It turns every post, ad, and deck into a 5-minute task.

slots.title: Automate user
slots.body: Build a 5-email sequence and an in-app checklist that activates new users while you sleep. It’s your 24/7 customer success team.

slots.title: Build a
slots.body: Pull revenue, churn, and acquisition into one real-time dashboard. Data-driven decisions separate operators from hobbyists.

slots.title: Deploy your
slots.body: Use agents for support tickets, content drafts, and code review. You get parallel output without parallel payroll.
Pick one tool this week and build it in public. Speed is a feature, and your solo stack is the unfair advantage.
